lines.zh: 探針卡裡有一片 MLO 載板：上面接探針，下面接主板。
lines.en: Inside a probe card sits an MLO substrate: probes on top, the PCB underneath.

lines.zh: 它的工作叫扇出：把八十微米的探針間距，一路攤開到主板上一毫米的錫球。
lines.en: Its job is fan-out: spreading an 80-micron probe pitch out to millimetre solder balls on the PCB.

lines.zh: 拆開來看：中間是核心板，上下各壓了好幾層增層，
lines.en: Take it apart: a core in the middle, several build-up layers on each side,

lines.zh: 有細線路的訊號層，也有整片的電源層和地層。
lines.en: fine-line signal layers, and solid power and ground planes.

lines.zh: 剖開來，層與層之間靠雷射打出來的微孔相連，一層疊一層。
lines.en: Cut it open: laser-drilled microvias join the layers, stacked one on another.

lines.zh: 每一層是這樣做出來的：壓上增層膜、雷射鑽孔、除膠渣、長一層化學銅，
lines.en: Each layer is made like this: laminate a film, laser-drill the vias, desmear, grow a seed of copper,

lines.zh: 上光阻、電鍍、去光阻、把多餘的銅蝕刻掉。一層做完，再做下一層。
lines.en: add resist, plate, strip, and etch away the rest. One layer done, on to the next.

lines.zh: 探針越密，中間幾排就越難拉出來，
lines.en: The finer the pitch, the harder it is to route the inner rows out,

lines.zh: 得用更細的線，或更多層。
lines.en: so you need finer lines, or more layers.

lines.zh: 加熱到一百二十五度：有機材料膨脹得比矽多，角落的探針就對不準了。
lines.en: Heat it to 125 degrees: the organic substrate grows more than silicon, and the corner probes miss their pads.

lines.zh: 所以探針圖案會先照測試溫度縮放。
lines.en: So the probe pattern is pre-scaled for the test temperature.

lines.zh: 上下兩面的銅如果不平衡，冷卻之後整片就會翹起來。
lines.en: And if the copper on the two sides is unbalanced, the substrate bows as it cools.

lines.zh: MLO 平不平、準不準，決定了上萬支探針能不能同時碰好。
lines.en: How flat and true the MLO is decides whether tens of thousands of probes can land at once.

lines.zh: 用 Claude Opus 5.5 做的，直接在瀏覽器裡就能玩。
lines.en: Built with Claude Opus 5.5 — it runs live in your browser.
